MOUNTAIN PROVINCE AS TOLL ROAD AND
FIXING SCHEDULE OF FEES FOR THE COLLEC-
TION OF TOLLS THEREON
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, Diosdado
Macapagal, President of the Philippines, do hereby amend
the second paragraph, subparagraph (e), of Executive
Order No. 34, dated June 1, 1954, to read as follows:
"(e) Private-owned cars bearing plate numbers 1 to 15 of
officials of the Republic of the Philippines traveling on
official business."
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of September,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and sixty-two.
DIOSDADO MACAPAGAL
President of the Philippines
By the President:
SALVADOR L. MARIÑO
Executive Secretary
